Verified:
- PR #190 is open, mergeable, base main, exact head 3fb08e1f63bcedf4489293810e442d804a6d636c.
- All seven required independently named test methods exist.
- The committed report binds the implementation head and the Issue/PR surfaces externally bind the report-containing head.
- The reporter validates immutable admission, source, successful execution and PR provenance before consulting a terminal marker; code inspection therefore supports fail-closed behavior for those rejected inputs.
- Exact canonical remote-body equality replaces receipt-key substring acceptance.

Acceptance gaps:
1. The task required each rejected-input test to prove that a pre-existing terminal marker is not upgraded into validation. None of the seven new tests creates a pre-existing TASK_COMPLETED marker or asserts its bytes remain unchanged. They prove only no post and no validation record from a marker-absent fixture.
2. The report claims the admission cases exercise the pre-existing-marker boundary; the committed tests do not.
3. The report says the remote branch “currently resolves to implementation head”, but the current remote/PR head is the later report commit 3fb08e1f63bcedf4489293810e442d804a6d636c. This must be time-qualified as a pre-report checkpoint or corrected.
4. The Issue currently has CLAIMED, final-binding prose and EXECUTION_FINISHED, but no terminal TASK_COMPLETED/TASK_BLOCKED receipt. Exit status is not settlement.

Minimum safe continuation on the same PR/branch:
- add a helper that seeds an exact valid terminal marker from a valid baseline;
- in each of the seven rejection tests, mutate only the named invariant, assert the marker bytes are unchanged, no TASK_COMPLETED post occurs, and no validation record exists;
- correct the report’s two inaccurate evidence claims;
- rerun focused/full/diff/static checks;
- publish the new report-containing head, update PR #190 body and final Issue binding last, then emit an honest terminal outcome.

Do not create another branch or PR. Do not merge. Producer behavior looks promising, but REPORTER_VALIDATION_RECORD_READY is not accepted at this head.
